in_marathi.name: Deetika
in_marathi.long_meaning: Deetika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Deetika is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Dharma’, which means righteousness, law, or order. The name Deetika is a tribute to the divine feminine power that upholds morality and justice in the universe.
